Saudi Arabia Seeks Allies' Help for Low Missile Defenses

Saudi Arabia is reportedly seeking assistance from its allies as its missile defense systems are running low. Officials have indicated that the kingdom is reaching out to both Western and regional partners for support. The specific nature of the assistance required and the extent of the depletion of defense systems were not detailed in the coverage. The reports suggest a growing concern over the kingdom's defensive capabilities.
